description: Drafts must pass the shared workflow schema and use the trigger and step types the description implies.

cases.description: When a new lead comes in, create a task for the owner to call them the same day
When a deal is won, notify the owner and create a hand-over task due in two days
If a new lead's estimated value is at least 50000, tag it hot
When a contact is created, send them a welcome email
Two days after a lead is created, if it is still NEW, remind the owner
